sentences.en: Elon Musk is now the biggest shareholder in Twitter.
sentences.zh: 埃隆·马斯克现在是推特最大的股东。

sentences.en: Elon Musk just disclosed the purchase of over 73 million shares of Twitter.
sentences.zh: 埃隆·马斯克刚刚披露他购买了超过7300万股推特股票。

sentences.en: That makes him a 9.2%.
sentences.zh: 这使他持股比例达到9.2%。

sentences.en: Last week, when the billionaire entrepreneur Elon Musk made a major investment in Twitter.
sentences.zh: 上周，亿万富翁企业家埃隆·马斯克对推特进行了重大投资。

sentences.en: This is technically what's called a passive stake at the moment, but I don't think Elon Musk does anything in a passive way.
sentences.zh: 目前这在技术上被称为被动持股，但我认为埃隆·马斯克从不做任何被动的事。

sentences.en: I think this is the beginning of something bigger.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是更大事件的开端。

sentences.en: It was seen as a chance by the company to turn the business world's most unpredictable man into an ally.
sentences.zh: 公司曾将其视为一个机会，试图将这位商业界最不可预测的人变成盟友。

sentences.en: Instead, it has plunged Twitter into a very public drama over its future.
sentences.zh: 然而，这反而让推特陷入了一场关于其未来的公开闹剧之中。

sentences.en: I spoke with my colleague, technology reporter Mike Isaac.
sentences.zh: 我采访了我的同事、科技记者迈克·艾萨克。

sentences.en: It's Thursday,
sentences.zh: 今天是周四，

sentences.en: April 14th.
Mike, what is it about Silicon Valley and corporate drama?
sentences.zh: 迈克，硅谷和企业闹剧之间有什么联系吗？

sentences.en: That tends to go together like a horse and carriage?
sentences.zh: 它们是不是就像马和马车一样总是形影不离？

sentences.en: A horse and carriage, yeah.
sentences.zh: 马和马车，没错。

sentences.en: Speaking of drama, where does this drama begin?
sentences.zh: 说到闹剧，这场闹剧是从哪里开始的？

sentences.en: So, about two weeks ago, Elon Musk, as you know, the CEO of Tesla, the founder of SpaceX,
sentences.zh: 大约两周前，如你所知，特斯拉首席执行官、SpaceX创始人埃隆·马斯克，

sentences.en: early PayPal creator, guy who does a million things at once.
sentences.zh: 早期的PayPal创造者，一个同时做一百万件事的人。

sentences.en: And is fantastically wealthy.
sentences.zh: 而且富得惊人。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，确实。

sentences.en: He also happens to be the richest man in the world.
sentences.zh: 他恰好还是世界上最富有的人。

sentences.en: He decides to start buying up a bunch of shares of Twitter, Twitter the company.
sentences.zh: 他决定开始大量买入推特公司的股票。

sentences.en: He's a power user of the service.
sentences.zh: 他是该服务的重度用户。

sentences.en: He's someone who tweets a lot.
sentences.zh: 他是一个经常发推文的人。

sentences.en: If you follow him, he has 80 million plus followers.
sentences.zh: 如果你关注他，他有超过8000万粉丝。

sentences.en: And so, sort of quietly, without anyone really noticing, at least initially, he starts buying up shares of Twitter.
sentences.zh: 于是，他悄悄地，在几乎没人注意到的情况下，至少起初是这样，开始买入推特股票。

sentences.en: How many shares?
sentences.zh: 买了多少？

sentences.en: Yeah, not just a few.
sentences.zh: 是的，不仅仅是一点点。

sentences.en: He buys up millions of shares, basically amassing a sort of private pile that ultimately ends up to about 9.2% of outstanding shares in the entire company.
sentences.zh: 他买入了数百万股，基本上积累了一笔私人资产，最终占到整个公司流通股的9.2%左右。

sentences.en: Which is not a typical investment.
sentences.zh: 这可不是一般的投资。

sentences.en: It's just not beefing up your stock portfolio.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是增加你的股票投资组合。

sentences.en: That is a huge investment.
sentences.zh: 这是一笔巨额投资。

sentences.en: You do not call your E-Trade broker to buy up 10% of a company.
sentences.zh: 你不会打电话给你的E-Trade经纪人去买下一家公司10%的股份。

sentences.en: No, he ultimately becomes the company's largest shareholder through doing this, sort of quietly, basically.
sentences.zh: 不，他通过这种方式最终成为了公司最大的股东，基本上是悄悄地完成的。

sentences.en: No one really knows about it, except Twitter, Inc., you know, catches wind and basically is like, uh-oh, this is happening.
sentences.zh: 除了推特公司察觉到并意识到“噢，糟糕，这事儿发生了”之外，没人真正知道。

sentences.en: We need to do something about it.
sentences.zh: 我们需要对此采取行动。

sentences.en: And why is that an uh-oh moment for Twitter?
sentences.zh: 为什么这对推特来说是一个“噢，糟糕”的时刻？

sentences.en: Because the sense is that when he touches a company, it pretty much turns to gold for investors.
sentences.zh: 因为人们认为，当他接触一家公司时，对投资者来说，它几乎就会点石成金。

sentences.en: So why would he not be welcomed by Twitter?
sentences.zh: 那么为什么推特不欢迎他呢？

sentences.en: Why is Twitter thinking to itself, uh-oh?
sentences.zh: 为什么推特会觉得“噢，糟糕”？

sentences.en: Well, no, I mean, I think that's fair.
sentences.zh: 嗯，不，我的意思是，我认为这很公平。

sentences.en: I think, you know, look at Elon's past, right?
sentences.zh: 我想，你知道，看看埃隆的过去，对吧？

sentences.en: The world has been under this illusion that electric cars cannot be as good as gasoline cars.
sentences.zh: 世界一直处于一种错觉中，认为电动汽车不可能像汽油车那样好。

sentences.en: The guy revolutionized the electric car industry.
sentences.zh: 这家伙彻底改变了电动汽车行业。

sentences.en: It's showing that an electric car can, in fact, be the best car in the world.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，电动汽车实际上可以成为世界上最好的汽车。

sentences.en: That's what makes it really important.
sentences.zh: 这就是它真正重要的地方。

sentences.en: He turned Tesla, the company, into this sort of juggernaut on Wall Street.
sentences.zh: 他把特斯拉这家公司变成了华尔街的一种巨头。

sentences.en: And do you want the future where we become a space-faring civilization and are in many worlds?
sentences.zh: 你想拥有一个我们成为航天文明并存在于多个世界的未来吗？

sentences.en: With SpaceX is literally working with the government to put people into space, to carry payloads into space, you know, commercial sort of space travel in a way.
sentences.zh: SpaceX正在与政府合作，将人员送入太空，运送有效载荷进入太空，你知道，这是一种商业化的太空旅行。

sentences.en: I think we should really do our very best to become a multi-planet species and to extend consciousness beyond Earth.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们真的应该尽最大努力成为多行星物种，并将意识扩展到地球之外。

sentences.en: And we should do it now.
sentences.zh: 而且我们现在就应该这样做。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: You know, the guy is a big thinker, and you could argue that bringing a big thinker might be something that Twitter needs.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这家伙是个大思想家，你可以说引入一个大思想家可能是推特所需要的。

sentences.en: You know, maybe after years of criticism that Twitter the product has been stagnant or needs an overhaul, you know, maybe Elon Musk is the guy to do it.
sentences.zh: 你知道，也许在多年来批评推特产品停滞不前或需要彻底改革之后，也许埃隆·马斯克就是那个能做到这一点的人。

sentences.en: And, you know, as it happens, Elon does have a bunch of ideas about how to change it.
sentences.zh: 而且，正如你所知，埃隆确实对如何改变它有很多想法。

sentences.en: You know, often he kind of decides to go on Twitter and tweet out those ideas, basically riff on what the product should be or might look like at some point.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他经常决定在推特上发布这些想法，基本上是即兴发挥产品应该是什么样或未来可能是什么样。

sentences.en: There's this, like, bandied about idea of a
sentences.zh: 有一个被反复讨论的想法是关于

sentences.en: Twitter edit button, you know, something that doesn't exist right now.
sentences.zh: 推特编辑按钮，你知道，目前不存在的东西。

sentences.en: But if they did create it, it could look like maybe going back and changing your tweet if you misspelled something in it.
sentences.zh: 但如果他们真的创建了它，它可能看起来像是回去修改你的推文，以防你拼错了什么。

sentences.en: He also has poked at this idea of making Twitter open source and creating what he calls decentralized version of Twitter.
sentences.zh: 他还提出了将推特开源并创建他所谓的去中心化版本推特的想法。

sentences.en: The idea is essentially to let users kind of moderate themselves and decide what kind of Twitter they want to see, what version of the network they want to participate in.
sentences.zh: 这个想法本质上是让用户能够进行自我管理，并决定他们想看到什么样的推特，他们想参与哪个版本的网络。

sentences.en: And that's, you know, generally kind of the way Elon views the world.
sentences.zh: 这就是埃隆看待世界的方式。

sentences.en: You know, it's about giving power back to the users, kind of this, you know, free speech should flourish
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是关于把权力还给用户，某种程度上，你知道，言论自由应该在网上随处蓬勃发展，

sentences.en: everywhere online, whatever that, you know, might mean to you or me, and letting us choose our version of Twitter rather than Twitter Inc, you know, someone at the top.
sentences.zh: 无论这对你或我意味着什么，让我们选择我们自己的推特版本，而不是由推特公司，你知道，由高层的人来决定。

sentences.en: So basically, they see a successful businessman who has a lot of ideas on how to change and innovate the product.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上，他们看到的是一个成功的商人，他对如何改变和创新产品有很多想法。

sentences.en: And he has, you know, a track record of turning big ideas into potentially world changing businesses.
sentences.zh: 而且他有将大想法转化为可能改变世界的企业的记录。

sentences.en: And perhaps that's not necessarily a bad thing if he's if he's suddenly more interested in getting involved.
sentences.zh: 如果他突然对参与其中更感兴趣，那未必是一件坏事。

sentences.en: On the other hand, Elon is Elon.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，埃隆就是埃隆。

sentences.en: With Elon Musk comes a lot of baggage, I guess is what I would say.
sentences.zh: 我想说的是，埃隆·马斯克随之而来的是很多包袱。

sentences.en: So the guy is, you know, famously mercurial.
sentences.zh: 这家伙，你知道，以反复无常著称。

sentences.en: He decides to sort of do what he wants when he wants to do it, no matter what the consequences, often.
sentences.zh: 他决定随心所欲地做他想做的事，往往不顾后果。

sentences.en: What are some examples?
sentences.zh: 有什么例子吗？

sentences.en: So one of the most famous cases probably a few years back.
sentences.zh: 所以最著名的案例之一可能是几年前。

sentences.en: CEO Elon Musk creating chaos with a single tweet.
sentences.zh: 首席执行官埃隆·马斯克用一条推文制造了混乱。

sentences.en: Elon Musk tweeting that he is considering taking the company private at $420 per share.
sentences.zh: 埃隆·马斯克发推文说，他正在考虑以每股420美元的价格将公司私有化。

sentences.en: He tweeted that he was considering taking his company private at a stock price of $420.
sentences.zh: 他发推文说，他正在考虑以420美元的股价将他的公司私有化。

sentences.en: $420 a share.
sentences.zh: 每股420美元。

sentences.en: Where did $420 come from?
sentences.zh: 420美元是从哪里来的？

sentences.en: Well, initially, it seemed like a joke.
sentences.zh: 嗯，起初，这看起来像个玩笑。

sentences.en: $420 is what is it?
sentences.zh: 420美元是什么？

sentences.en: The pot number, right?
sentences.zh: 大麻的代号，对吧？

sentences.en: So like everyone
sentences.zh: 所以就像每个人

sentences.en: Oh, like you don't know that.
sentences.zh: 哦，好像你不知道。

sentences.en: That's what I've been told.
sentences.zh: 这就是我被告知的。

sentences.en: So everyone's like, ha ha ha.
sentences.zh: 所以每个人都说，哈哈哈哈。

sentences.en: But
sentences.zh: 但是

sentences.en: The SEC is suing Tesla CEO Elon Musk, accusing him of fraud and alleging that Musk issued false and misleading statements.
sentences.zh: 美国证券交易委员会正在起诉特斯拉首席执行官埃隆·马斯克，指控他欺诈，并声称马斯克发布了虚假和误导性声明。

sentences.en: You know, actually got him in a lot of trouble with the SEC and ended up being a full investigation.
sentences.zh: 你知道，实际上这让他惹上了美国证券交易委员会的很多麻烦，并最终导致了全面调查。

sentences.en: Now he and Tesla are paying the price to the tune of $40 million.
sentences.zh: 现在他和特斯拉正在付出代价，金额高达4000万美元。

sentences.en: It turns out he had to get a slap on the wrist and deal with a whole lot of regulatory issues.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，他不得不受到轻微惩罚，并处理了一大堆监管问题。

sentences.en: And that's the thing with him.
sentences.zh: 这就是他的问题所在。

sentences.en: You kind of never know what you're going to get.
sentences.zh: 你永远不知道你会得到什么。

sentences.en: If this dude who decides to have fun or have a joke, it has repercussions.
sentences.zh: 如果这个决定开玩笑或找乐子的家伙，它会产生连锁反应。

sentences.en: And that can have repercussions for your multi-billion dollar company that is traded publicly, that has stock prices that are connected to people's 401ks or portfolios.
sentences.zh: 这可能会对你的数十亿美元的上市公司产生影响，这些公司是公开交易的，其股价与人们的401k退休金或投资组合相关。

sentences.en: I think the other thing to think about is how, you know, some people think that Elon Musk sometimes uses Twitter in actually a pretty dangerous way.
sentences.zh: 我认为另一件需要考虑的事情是，你知道，有些人认为埃隆·马斯克有时以一种非常危险的方式使用推特。

sentences.en: And what do you mean by that?
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: He'll get into these sort of random scraps with people online, you know?
sentences.zh: 他会和网上的人发生这种随机的争吵，你知道吗？

sentences.en: I mean, you know,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你知道，

sentences.en: Twitter fights are not uncommon.
sentences.zh: 推特上的争吵并不罕见。

sentences.en: But when you're fighting against Elon Musk, it can end up with his sort of legions of fans kind of being sicked on different people.
sentences.zh: 但当你和埃隆·马斯克争吵时，最终可能会导致他那群粉丝去攻击不同的人。

sentences.en: For example, this, um, a few years back, there was a bunch of kids trapped in a cave in Thailand, I believe.
sentences.zh: 例如，这个，嗯，几年前，有一群孩子被困在泰国的洞穴里，我相信是这样。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I remember it.
sentences.zh: 我记得。

sentences.en: And there was a guy who was a cave diver.
sentences.zh: 有一个人是洞穴潜水员。

sentences.en: He was trying to go and sort of save these kids.
sentences.zh: 他试图去拯救这些孩子。

sentences.en: The story becomes national news.
sentences.zh: 这个故事成了全国新闻。

sentences.en: Elon Musk says a device he built is on its way to Thailand to help with the cave rescue efforts.
sentences.zh: 埃隆·马斯克说他制造的一个装置正在运往泰国，以帮助洞穴救援工作。

sentences.en: Elon Musk gets involved.
sentences.zh: 埃隆·马斯克参与其中。

sentences.en: He says he's going to send a submarine.
sentences.zh: 他说他要派一艘潜艇。

sentences.en: The cave diver guy essentially says it wouldn't have made the first 50 meters into the cave from from the dive start point.
sentences.zh: 洞穴潜水员基本上说，从潜水起点算起，它甚至无法进入洞穴的前50米。

sentences.en: Musk's efforts weren't that helpful.
sentences.zh: 马斯克的努力并没有什么帮助。

sentences.en: Just just a PR stunt.
sentences.zh: 只是一个公关噱头。

sentences.en: And so Musk responded in a series of tweets where he called the diver a pedo guy referring to the
sentences.zh: 所以马斯克在一系列推文中回应，称潜水员为“恋童癖者”，指的是

sentences.en: Musk decides to lash back out at the guy by calling him essentially a pedophile with no proof on Twitter, which is crazy.
sentences.zh: 马斯克决定在推特上反击那个人，称他基本上是恋童癖，没有任何证据，这太疯狂了。

sentences.en: And, um, once he says that his millions of followers who adore Elon sort of can go after the cave diving guy who is sort of an innocent bystander throughout this whole thing
sentences.zh: 而且，嗯，一旦他这么说，他那数百万崇拜埃隆的粉丝就可以去攻击那个洞穴潜水员，他在整个事情中基本上是一个无辜的旁观者，

sentences.en: because Elon decided to get mad at him.
sentences.zh: 因为埃隆决定对他发火。

sentences.en: So essentially he acts like a troll and he happens to be one of the world's most powerful executives.
sentences.zh: 所以本质上他表现得像个喷子，而他恰好是世界上最有权势的高管之一。

sentences.en: I think troll is a perfect way to describe him.
sentences.zh: 我认为“喷子”是形容他的完美方式。

sentences.en: I think he probably would acknowledge that himself.
sentences.zh: 我想他自己可能也会承认这一点。

sentences.en: And half the time you don't know if he's serious or not, which is potentially dangerous to have at the helm of a public company.
sentences.zh: 而且有一半的时间你不知道他是认真的还是开玩笑，这对于一家上市公司的掌舵人来说可能是危险的。

sentences.en: I think the other thing Twitter is thinking about at this point too is not just, you know, whether the guy is going to troll people, you know, online or troll the
sentences.zh: 我认为推特此时考虑的另一件事不仅仅是，你知道，这家伙是否会在网上喷人或喷公司，

sentences.en: company, but the world's richest man is buying up a significant amount of your stock all at once.
sentences.zh: 而是世界上最富有的人正在一次性买入你大量的股票。

sentences.en: And they're thinking, is this the grounds for an eventual takeover?
sentences.zh: 他们在想，这是否是最终收购的理由？

sentences.en: You know, you have to remember that Elon years ago was not the original CEO of Tesla.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你必须记住，埃隆多年前并不是特斯拉最初的首席执行官。

sentences.en: He, he came in later after he initiated a takeover of that company.
sentences.zh: 他是在发起对该公司的收购后才加入的。

sentences.en: Um, not exactly a welcome one.

sentences.zh: 马斯克在推特上的回应仅限于一个“捂嘴”的表情符号。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: But why do we think that would be?
sentences.zh: 但我们认为这是为什么呢？

sentences.en: And why would he suddenly not want to be on the board?
sentences.zh: 他为什么突然不想加入董事会了？

sentences.en: I think at some point over the weekend, you know, Elon essentially realized that agreeing to be on
sentences.zh: 我想在周末的某个时候，你知道，埃隆基本上意识到，同意加入

sentences.en: the board of a company comes with a lot more strings than he wants to be attached, right?
sentences.zh: 一家公司的董事会伴随着比他想要的更多的束缚，对吧？

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: One of the agreements is acting in the best interest of the company's shareholders.
sentences.zh: 其中一项协议是必须以公司股东的最佳利益行事。

sentences.en: It's called fiduciary responsibility, you know?
sentences.zh: 这叫信托责任，你知道吗？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You can't lob criticisms like grenades at the company when you feel like it on a Saturday because you're bored, you know?
sentences.zh: 你不能因为无聊，就在周六随心所欲地像扔手榴弹一样对公司进行批评，你知道吗？

sentences.en: And I think Elon doesn't like being put in a box that way.
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得埃隆不喜欢被那样束缚住。

sentences.en: He almost preferred his initial positioning, which was, I'm already a guy with tens of millions of followers.
sentences.zh: 他几乎更喜欢他最初的定位，也就是，我本来就是一个拥有数千万粉丝的人。

sentences.en: I'm already, you know, amassing a good amount of stock.
sentences.zh: 我本来就已经，你知道，积累了相当多的股票。

sentences.en: You have to listen to me anyway.
sentences.zh: 反正你们都得听我的。

sentences.en: Why would I sort of feel handcuffed or, you know, silenced on the board of directors when I can do it from the outside?
sentences.zh: 既然我可以在外部行事，为什么还要在董事会里感到束手束脚，或者说，被噤声呢？

sentences.en: And I think he figured that out and decided, nope, I'm out.
sentences.zh: 我想他想通了这一点，于是决定，不，我不干了。

sentences.en: I don't want to do it.
sentences.zh: 我不想做这件事。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So what should we take from all this?
sentences.zh: 那么我们应该从这一切中得出什么结论呢？

sentences.en: Because on the one hand, this may seem like the simple story of a renegade businessman who doesn't want to be penned in by the rules.
sentences.zh: 因为一方面，这看起来可能只是一个叛逆商人不想被规则束缚的简单故事。

sentences.en: But I'm now remembering that you told us that part of the deal he signed onto was that he wouldn't buy more and more of Twitter's stock and therefore couldn't take it over.
sentences.zh: 但我现在想起来你告诉过我们，他签署的协议中有一部分是他不会购买更多的推特股票，因此无法接管它。

sentences.en: So if he backs out of this deal, should we also assume that he's now free and perhaps desires to keep taking over more and more of Twitter?
sentences.zh: 所以如果他退出了这笔交易，我们是否也应该假设他现在自由了，并且可能渴望继续收购更多的推特股票？

sentences.en: That is a correct assumption.
sentences.zh: 这个假设是正确的。

sentences.en: All bets are off essentially at this point.
sentences.zh: 从本质上讲，现在一切皆有可能。

sentences.en: That agreement that he made, which is called a standstill agreement to not buy more stock, no longer is applicable.
sentences.zh: 他所达成的那个协议，也就是所谓的“静止协议”，即不购买更多股票，已经不再适用了。

sentences.en: On Monday, the very next day after the announcement, there was another filing basically says, Mr. Musk no longer has to abide by the previous agreement.
sentences.zh: 周一，也就是公告发布的第二天，又有一份文件基本上说，马斯克先生不再需要遵守之前的协议了。

sentences.en: He can buy more stock if he wishes to.
sentences.zh: 如果他愿意，他可以购买更多股票。

sentences.en: He can initiate a hostile takeover of the company if he wishes to.
sentences.zh: 如果他愿意，他可以对该公司发起恶意收购。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: My favorite line was, he can change his plans at any time if he so wishes, which is probably the most Elon thing ever.
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢的一句话是，如果他愿意，他可以随时改变计划，这大概是最具“埃隆风格”的事情了。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: Which was true before that statement came out.
sentences.zh: 这在声明发布之前也是事实。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: So now we're back to this big cosmic question, which is what would it look like if Elon Musk were to try to take over Twitter?
sentences.zh: 所以现在我们又回到了这个宏大的宇宙级问题，那就是如果埃隆·马斯克试图接管推特，会是什么样子？

sentences.en: Because Twitter is a big deal.
sentences.zh: 因为推特是一件大事。

sentences.en: It's easy to dismiss Twitter.
sentences.zh: 人们很容易轻视推特。

sentences.en: It's an addiction.
sentences.zh: 它让人上瘾。

sentences.en: It's a place people go to talk trash about each other.
sentences.zh: 它是人们去互相谩骂的地方。

sentences.en: But it's also one of the world's great town squares.
sentences.zh: 但它也是世界上伟大的公共广场之一。

sentences.en: It's where revolutions like the Arab Spring have been amplified and spread.
sentences.zh: 它是像“阿拉伯之春”这样的革命被放大和传播的地方。

sentences.en: It's where conspiracy theories and extremism have festered.
sentences.zh: 它是阴谋论和极端主义滋生的地方。

sentences.en: It's an important part of the global conversation.
sentences.zh: 它是全球对话的重要组成部分。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全正确。

sentences.en: And I think the big question mark for a lot of folks is what does he want to do with it?
sentences.zh: 我认为对很多人来说，最大的问号是他想用它做什么？

sentences.en: He has for a long time said he thinks there needs to be big changes.
sentences.zh: 他长期以来一直说，他认为推特需要进行重大变革。

sentences.en: He thinks that, for example, Twitter might restrict certain types of speech that he feels is really important to have out there.
sentences.zh: 他认为，例如，推特可能会限制某些他觉得非常有必要公之于众的言论。

sentences.en: It's a similar sort of refrain to a lot of conservatives feel like big tech is oppressing conservative speech on the platform or tamping down what should be louder voices.
sentences.zh: 这与许多保守派的论调类似，他们觉得大型科技公司正在压制平台上的保守派言论，或者压制本应更响亮的声音。

sentences.en: And I think
sentences.zh: 而且我认为

sentences.en: Elon Musk has a lot in common with that point of view.
sentences.zh: 埃隆·马斯克与那种观点有很多共同之处。

sentences.en: On the other hand, you know, folks believe that Twitter needs even more reigning in and it's a really toxic place a lot of the time for a lot of
sentences.zh: 另一方面，你知道，人们认为推特需要更多的约束，而且对于很多使用该服务的人来说，它在很多时候确实是一个非常糟糕的地方，你知道，也许吧。

sentences.en: people who use the service, you know, perhaps.
sentences.zh: 也许吧。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: In fact, that's why there's so much talk about regulating Twitter as well as its fellow social media platforMs. Facebook, TikTok, all of them, of course.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这就是为什么关于监管推特以及其他社交媒体平台（如脸书、TikTok，当然还有所有这些平台）的讨论如此之多。

sentences.en: And, you know, that version is sort of in line with the way Twitter has been going over the past few years.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，那个版本与推特过去几年的发展方向是一致的。

sentences.en: You know, they've been building more tools to handle harassment.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们一直在构建更多的工具来处理骚扰问题。

sentences.en: They've been amping up, along with Facebook, their moderation sort of abilities and trying to cut down on all of that misinformation and vitriol that you've been referencing.
sentences.zh: 他们一直在与脸书一起，加强他们的审核能力，并试图减少你所提到的所有那些错误信息和尖刻言论。

sentences.en: And so it's almost like two different paths that people are sort of looking at and wondering, which one are we going to go down?
sentences.zh: 所以这几乎就像是人们正在观察的两条不同的道路，并想知道，我们将走哪一条？

sentences.en: And I think the thing that folks are left with now is the question of what is he going to do next?
sentences.zh: 我认为人们现在留下的问题是，他接下来要做什么？

sentences.en: And, you know, that's sort of always been the question around Elon.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这似乎一直是围绕埃隆的问题。

sentences.en: But I think we have to revert to what we know about Elon.
sentences.zh: 但我认为我们必须回归到我们对埃隆的了解。

sentences.en: You know, the guy goes into every industry he wants to all the way.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这家伙进入他想要的每一个行业都是全力以赴的。

sentences.en: You know, he's not a 50 percent type of guy.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他不是那种只做一半的人。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Whether that's pushing into the space industry, whether it's electrifying cars, whether it's
sentences.zh: 无论是进军航天工业，还是电动汽车，亦或是

sentences.en: changing how people pay for stuff online, you know, with PayPal, he's really just gone all the way and transformed a lot of these industries.
sentences.zh: 改变人们在线支付的方式，你知道，通过PayPal，他确实是全力以赴，并改变了许多这些行业。

sentences.en: And so, you know, he has a history of doing this.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，他有这样做的历史。

sentences.en: But I think Twitter is kind of different.
sentences.zh: 但我认为推特有点不同。

sentences.en: It's not a hardware company.
sentences.zh: 它不是一家硬件公司。

sentences.en: It's a communication service.
sentences.zh: 它是一项通信服务。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You know, and even if your mom or your neighbor down the street isn't on Twitter, they're somehow being sort of touched by what goes on on the service.
sentences.zh: 你知道，即使你的妈妈或街对面的邻居没有使用推特，他们也会以某种方式受到该服务上发生的事情的影响。

sentences.en: You know, all of the stuff that happens on Twitter tends to leak out across other media, whether it's TV, Facebook or the front page of The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 你知道，推特上发生的所有事情往往会泄露到其他媒体上，无论是电视、脸书还是《纽约时报》的头版。

sentences.en: Indeed.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: So I think it really does matter with his intentions for this service.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为他对比这项服务的意图确实很重要。

sentences.en: And and, you know, whatever you think about Elon Musk, you can't deny that the guy's been transformative.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，无论你对埃隆·马斯克有什么看法，你都不能否认这家伙具有变革性。

sentences.en: And now now he's looking at a platform used by hundreds of millions of people, and he wants to transform it.
sentences.zh: 现在他正在审视一个被数亿人使用的平台，他想要改变它。

sentences.en: And when Elon Musk wants to transform something, history shows that he transforms it.
sentences.zh: 当埃隆·马斯克想要改变某样东西时，历史表明他确实能改变它。

sentences.en: Or he could just be trolling all of us.
sentences.zh: 或者他可能只是在戏弄我们所有人。

sentences.en: I mean, or he could be just trolling all of us.
sentences.zh: 我是说，或者他可能只是在戏弄我们所有人。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: All right, Mike.
sentences.zh: 好的，迈克。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你邀请我。

sentences.en: On Thursday morning, Elon Musk offered to buy Twitter outright in a $43 billion hostile takeover.
sentences.zh: 周四上午，埃隆·马斯克提出以430亿美元的价格对推特进行恶意收购，要求全资收购。

sentences.en: If the offer is not accepted, Musk said in a government filing, he would need to reconsider his investment in the company.
sentences.zh: 马斯克在提交给政府的文件中表示，如果报价不被接受，他将需要重新考虑他在该公司的投资。

sentences.en: In the filing, Musk said, quote, quote, Twitter has extraordinary potential.
sentences.zh: 在文件中，马斯克说，引用一下，“推特拥有非凡的潜力。”

sentences.en: I will unlock it.
sentences.zh: “我将释放它。”

sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.zh: 我的纽约同胞们，我们抓到他了。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, New York City police arrested the suspect in the city's worst subway shooting in decades, 62-year-old Frank James, who was captured in the East Village of Manhattan.
sentences.zh: 周三，纽约市警方逮捕了该市几十年来最严重的地铁枪击案嫌疑人，62岁的弗兰克·詹姆斯，他在曼哈顿东村被捕。

sentences.en: James is accused of putting on a gas mask, detonating two smoke grenades, and shooting
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯被指控戴上防毒面具，引爆两枚烟雾弹，并向

sentences.en: 10 people inside a Manhattan-bound N train on Tuesday morning.
sentences.zh: 周二早上开往曼哈顿的N号线列车内的10人开枪。

sentences.en: Police have yet to identify a possible motive, but said that James had left crucial evidence at the scene, including a credit
sentences.zh: 警方尚未确定可能的动机，但表示詹姆斯在现场留下了关键证据，包括一张写有他名字的信用卡

sentences.en: card with his name on it and the key to a van that he had rented.
sentences.zh: 以及他租用的一辆货车的钥匙。
